what_this_answers: Does the CURRENT governor and the CURRENT scorer treat the real Sprint-5 recorded model output the same way the Sprint-5 engine did? It does NOT answer whether the models would still say this.

corpus_coverage.note: A colliding normalised subject is the ONLY condition the identity-key fix acts on. Where the count above is zero, this replay provides NO evidence about that fix on this corpus -- it shows the fix changed nothing here because it could not apply, which is a different statement from the fix being correct. Fresh cases that actually collide are needed for that, and this report must not be cited as covering it.

classification_policy: FAILS CLOSED. A difference is EXPLAINED only when a named rule inspected the real values and returned a reason; everything else is a DEFECT. There is no rule of last resort.
model_calls_assertion: 0, asserted not claimed: every provider was a transcripts.ReplaySource, and cli_transport.run_cli -- the only function in this package through which a live subscription turn can leave the process -- was replaced for the duration of the replay by a counter that raises. The value above is that real counter. Honest limit: it proves nothing left via run_cli, which is the only exit this package has today.
